description: The removal of the existing sprinkler system within the North and South towers of Tower Bridge while installing a new fire sprinkler system covering: North and South Towers; North and South Abutments; High-level Walkways; Reservoir, Engine Rooms and Shop. The replacement of the gas suppression system within the 4no. Machine Rooms below the North and South towers. The connection of the sprinkler and gas suppression systems to the BMS. The replacement of the boosted mains and domestic cold-water systems to the North and South towers.
